definitions.explanation: Taking care of a problem or situation, cleaning up, or dealing with the aftermath of something. Often implies tidying up a mess or resolving a troublesome situation.
The way things have turned out, especially a bad or troublesome outcome. Used to describe an unfortunate state that has resulted from someone's actions. Often carries a tone of exasperation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{始末|しまつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧つけ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後始末|あとしまつ}→後始末：07911_atoshimatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われている→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: We are busy dealing with the aftermath of the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{散|ち}らかした→散らかす：04360_chirakasu⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{始末|しまつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}かけ→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Tidy up the messy room before you go out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{聞|き}か→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ず、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{始末|しまつ}だ。
examples.english: No matter how many times I warned them, they wouldn't listen, and this is the result.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{挙句|あげく}→挙句：12709_ageku⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}す→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{始末|しまつ}だ。
examples.english: After pushing too hard, the outcome was that they ruined their health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{約束|やくそく}を{破|やぶ}った→約束を破る：20639_yakusokuwoyaburu⟧⟦{挙句|あげく}→挙句：12709_ageku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆|ぎゃく}ギレ→逆ギレ：17470_gyakugire⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{始末|しまつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{呆|あき}れて→呆れる：06720_akireru⟧しまった。
examples.english: After breaking the promise, they had the nerve to get angry — I was dumbfounded at how things turned out.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {始末|しまつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to settle/take care of a matter
- {始末|しまつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: hard to deal with, troublesome
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧{始末|しまつ}: cleanup, dealing with the aftermath
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{始末|しまつ}だ: this is the (sorry) result
- 〜⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{始末|しまつ}だ: ...is how things ended up (exasperated)
- {始末|しまつ}{書|しょ}: written apology/incident report

SENSE DISTINCTION:
Sense 1 (management) is active — you {始末|しまつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ something. Sense 2 (outcome) is descriptive — you observe ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{始末|しまつ} (this sorry state). The pattern 〜⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{始末|しまつ}だ or ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{始末|しまつ}だ expresses the speaker's exasperation at a bad outcome.
